notes.title: Youtube Patch: Dodge mode and More
notes.content:
Hello all, as you may or may not have known, Youtube made an update to their API that temporarily broke the youtube streaming.  That error is patched.

Additionally we've added a few extra.

1. Dodge mode.  Work on getting quick feet by playing with ONLY dodges.
2. Do not get tangled.  Notes will rotate in a way to keep you untangled.
3. Optimize the song download for faster speed.

notes.title: Update 2.0: HUUUGE Graphics Overhaul, Oculus Support, Haptics, Performance, and More
notes.content:
We have been spending our winter time off working on a major update based 100% on your community feedback!

1. HUUUUGE Graphics update as requested by the community.  It's practically a brand new game!

2. Oculus + Touch support!

3. Audio performance enhancements!  Our new algorithm will have you sweating in no time!  

4. Tons of little performance improvements for those who have experienced crashing. 

5. Improved haptics for weightier punches.

6. Support for arbitrary directory and file limits in the file browser.

7. Added support for external camera for producing mix reality videos

8. Streaming download progress indicator.

9.  Completely revamped UI interface.

Hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: New Update! Local file support, improved haptics, & More
notes.content:
Ask and you shall receive.  All of these updates are based on your feedback since our release last week:

1. Local file support

Local file support allows you to play local mp3 files from your computer.  Now you have 3 music choices.  Your own music, any youtube song (ad free), or streaming your favorite music app through airplay, (Spotify, Pandora, etc.)

2. Improved haptic feedback

You can now control the intensity of the haptic feedback when boxing a beat. The intensity ranges from nothing to "punching a brick wall".

3. Menu music & crowd volume

Ability to turn down the menu music or crowd.

4. Standing mode (180 degrees)

For those who do not want to turn a full 360 degrees standing mode keeps the beats coming at your from just 180 degrees.

5. Color blind mode

We were asked particularly for this, and hope that our color blind mode makes the game playable for those who cannot see colors as well.  We did a lot of research, but neither one of us is colorblind.  Those of you who are, we would love your feedback on this mode.

Keep the feedback coming.  We will continues making updates!
